text: That diagnosis does not align with your reported symptoms of acute joint swelling, urinary pain, and elevated inflammatory markers; those findings are inconsistent with Multiple Sclerosis. Given the recurrent monoarthritis and sterile pyuria, I suspect a diagnosis of Reactive Arthritis or Gonococcal arthritis instead. Do you have a history of a gastrointestinal infection or recent sexually transmitted infection prior to these joint symptoms?
